lines.text: Castle Ambry, after the last tour. The gift shop is shut. The stairs keep going.
Halt! Oh, thank goodness. Are you from the council?
Close enough. How's it looking down there?
That armor isn't one of ours. Something in the cellar ate the map. The rats have a king now. I bowed. I panicked.
Something very large, asleep on what I'd hoped was the gift shop float. It has been breathing on the stairs.
Nobody said anything about a dragon.
